title: Tech Note: 4D Server Health - Automatic Reporting
author: Thomas Maul, General Manager, 4D Germany.
featured_technology: On Server Startup / On Server Shutdown / On Startup / On Exit database methods
PLATFORM PROPERTIES, Application version, and other system-introspection commands

historical_commentary.text: This note describes a self-built 4D Server monitoring/reporting system that gathers OS, memory, disk, process, table, and crash-history data and emails or web-publishes it as an HTML report — a classic DIY ops-monitoring approach from an era before dedicated application performance monitoring was common in the 4D ecosystem. The specific implementation (4D Internet Commands plug-in for email, 4Daction web publishing, 4D Insider-based method copying) reflects tooling and APIs that have evolved significantly, but the underlying concept of proactive automated health/status reporting for a database server remains a relevant best practice, now more often achieved via 4D's built-in SMTP/HTTP client commands or external monitoring integrations.
related_updates: 4D Internet Commands plug-in functionality has largely been folded into or superseded by native 4D language commands (e.g. SMTP/POP3, HTTP client commands) in later 4D versions
4D Insider as a separate tool for cross-database method management predates later built-in component and code management features
4Daction-based web publishing predates 4D's modern Web Server/ REST and Qodly-based approaches
